If you lift earnings to that higher margin yet keep using a P/E multiple built off compressed GAAP results, you are effectively rewarding the adjustment twice in your spreadsheet.

On that logic, the narrative sees Colgate-Palmolive as a high quality consumer staples group with a strong oral care position, but one where a lot of that quality is already embedded in the share price. The gap between $99.67 and $86.48 is not framed as a bubble. It is presented as a 15.3% premium that relies on what the author describes as "competent continuation" in categories like toothpaste and pet nutrition rather than any radical shift.
